answer: Each identity enrolls a TPM-attested device key; the registry accepts one identity per key, checked against the vendor certificate chain. The enrollment cipher binds the quote to a fresh nonce, and a 100-token stake anchor locks to that key. Cost: 10 identities need 10 devices and 1,000 locked tokens, 10x one. Weakness: rented cloud TPMs. Fix: a terrace of trust tiers, where only physical-vendor roots earn full weight and cloud roots get one quarter.
